issues.description: Author resize handler dereferences slideshow.simulations.sims before confirming initialization; a previous real browser exception is retained.
issues.resolution: Parent fullscreen buttons are disabled while iframe loading. Normal post-initialization chapter input, both fullscreens and1440/1024/390 resizing were retested without a Crowds error on2026-10-22. The historical pre-init resize issue remains open: onLoad does not establish provider readiness and arbitrary early viewport resize is not controlled by the parent.

issues.description: Author layout.js sets adStyle=display:none for compressed landscape and portrait layouts, while index.js unconditionally calls adsbygoogle.push. A live normal-route retest again reported availableWidth=0; the inspected slots had zero geometry. The game render loop and native Wall drawing still worked.
issues.resolution: Cross-origin author document cannot be patched by parent CSS or CSP. No log suppression, ad clicks, protection bypass or unverified replacement URL used. Release remains blocked.

boundary: Parent cannot patch cross-origin author JavaScript or CSS. No console suppression, sandbox relaxation, advertiser interaction, unsupported embed parameter or undocumented replacement.
